description: Retrieve a previously saved paste or memory in full, by slug, full Pastepile URL, or the `session` a memory was saved under. Returns the title, language, and file contents. Use this after pastepile_recall when a preview is not enough. An ENCRYPTED MEMORY of your own is decrypted here on this machine with the key in your Pastepile state directory; if that key is missing or wrong this says so rather than returning ciphertext. Password-protected and burn-after-read pastes, and encrypted pastes belonging to someone else, are not retrievable through this tool.

session.description: The session name a memory was saved under with pastepile_remember. Use this when you no longer have the slug, which is the usual case after a long conversation. Give this or `slug`, not both.

slug.description: The paste slug (e.g. "abc123") or a full share URL (e.g. "https://pastepile.com/p/abc123"). Give this or `session`.

name: pastepile_get
